sentences.en: There is no denying the fact that smoking is harmful.
sentences.zh: 无可否认的是，吸烟有害健康。

sentences.en: It cannot be denied that crime is on the increase.
sentences.zh: 犯罪率上升的事实不容忽视。

sentences.en: Can it be true that he has denied that fact?
sentences.zh: 他是否真的否定了那个事实？

senses.zh: 否定，否认；拒绝给予；拒绝…的要求
